notes: V0.9.2: forgot password with security questions. Login screen gains a 'Forgot password?' link; Settings -> Privacy and security gains 'Security questions' setup. The private key is encrypted with a key derived from the two answers (PBKDF2, salt 'qs-recovery:'+username) and stored as a recovery blob; the server only ever sees the question texts, the SHA-256 hashes of the normalized answers, and the blob — never the answers or the private key. Answering correctly lets you set a new password and keep your identity and old messages. Server (worker-v092.js) adds /security-questions, /forgot-password, /reset-password and /admin/prune (deletes all users except one, requires the ADMIN_KEY secret) — deploy with bash cloudflare.sh. Also gates push registration behind pushReady (v0.9.1 crash fix).
